snippet.title: The Alters | Free Major Content Update Trailer
snippet.description:
💜Play #TheAlters now: https://re.11bits.com/ybc
📜Full changelog: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1601570/view/536620574115366164

The Free Major Content Update for #TheAlters is now available on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

Jump back into Jan Dolski’s journey with the new free update, bringing new systems, fresh customization options, and player-requested features to the game.

✔ What’s new:

▶️ New Save System
▶️ Photo Mode
▶️ Base & Spacesuit customization, 
▶️ Relax Mode, and more!
